summary: Three desktop chat fixes. Scrolling up a long chat prefetches the previous history window once the first turn in view is among the oldest quarter of the loaded turns, or 3,000 px from the top, whichever comes first, so the user does not reach the top while it loads; prepending it and measuring the new rows no longer moves or blanks the view (the list now re-renders the rows' positions in the same frame as a scroll correction, and renders the rows around the kept row before the frame after a prepend). After Cmd+L the composer caret sits right after the inserted chip instead of before it. Cmd+L also quotes the user's own messages, attributed to "you", with the chips in them read as their labels. MessageList's inline styles moved to Tailwind classes with no visible change.

reactNativeIos.reason: The Expo thread is an inverted FlatList that already loads older rows at onEndReachedThreshold 0.3, before the end, and an inverted list adds them past the visible end without moving the rows in view. It has no Cmd+L context bridge and its composer is a plain TextInput with no chips.

nativeAndroid.reason: The Android thread is a reversed LazyColumn whose older rows are added past the visible end, which keeps the rows in view in place; it has no Cmd+L context bridge and no inline chips in its composer.

sharedBackendApi.reason: Renderer-only change; the history window request and every channel are unchanged.

storageDataMigration.reason: Nothing stored changes. A quote is an ordinary chat-message draft pill, as before.

updateRelease.reason: Ships with the next desktop release; no packaging or channel change.

automated: tests/unit/desktop-history-window.test.ts covers the prefetch rule: the pixel distance, the oldest quarter of turns, no turn in view, no older rows, a load in flight.

e2e/history-prepend.e2e.mjs seeds a 700-row chat, scrolls up in steps and samples the row in view on every frame, scroll event, React commit and ResizeObserver pass: it stays within 1 px and mounted, the previous window lands at a scroll offset above 1,000 px, and no row other than a turn appears. Without the fix the window landed at 297 px and 107 samples moved by up to 411 px.
tests/unit/context-formatters.test.ts and tests/unit/chat-quote-text.test.ts cover the quote author and the chip-as-label selection text.

e2e/composer-context.e2e.mjs: after Cmd+L from a chat message, typing continues right after the chip with the caret at the end, in the middle, and after a second chip; Cmd+L on the user's own message with two chips gives a quote from "you" with the chip labels in one line. The caret checks fail without the fix (the text lands before the chip). e2e/radix-overlays.e2e.mjs keeps its focus-return caret checks green.
Visual regression screens passed twice with no new baselines after the Tailwind move.
notExercised: Not clicked through in the installed app with a real trackpad scroll; the e2e drives the scroll position directly. Cmd+L from a terminal and from the IDE share the changed insert path but were not run in the e2e. The phones were judged from their code, not run.
